survey.name: purpose
survey.label: ReliefIntel field observation. Do not include reporter names, phone numbers or identifying details. This form records reports for review; it does not authorize travel.

survey.name: report_mode
survey.label: Is this a demonstration or a real observation?

survey.name: observed_at
survey.label: When was the situation observed? Include the local timezone.

survey.name: place_name
survey.label: Where? Use the community name and local landmark.

survey.name: location
survey.label: Optional location pin
survey.hint: Leave blank if the location is uncertain. Do not record a reporter's private location.

survey.name: category
survey.label: What kind of observation is this?

survey.name: report_text
survey.label: Describe only what was observed or reported.

survey.name: origin_reference
survey.label: Optional original report reference
survey.hint: Use a report code, not a person's name or phone number. A forwarded copy is not an independent witness.

survey.name: uncertainty
survey.label: Unconfirmed reports and map locations remain uncertain until checked. Missing reports do not mean a road is clear.

choices.name: service_status
choices.label: Clinic, water point or service status
